_what: How each SSAC abstract slot is printed. Read by tools/comms/export_numbers.R, which writes the printed strings into docs/numbers.json, and by tools/comms/fill_slots.R, which pastes them. Rounding happens once, in the exporter, so the number gate sees in the ledger exactly what the abstract prints.
_kinds: count: an integer, printed with thousands commas, no interval. estimate: a point and a 95% interval, printed 'P (95% CI L to H)'. range: a published range, printed 'L to H'. owner: a sentence or a year the owner writes at review R1; no agent fills it. estimate90: a point and the 90% interval of a pre-registered equivalence test (CH1-A3), printed 'P (90% CI L to H)'. value: a point alone, printed with the slot's suffix.
_orient: signed prints the estimate as the model reports it: a negative area is a loss. contraction prints it negated, with the bounds swapped, so a loss reads as a positive number in a sentence about 'the contraction', as in the SOP's worked example '9.1 (95% CI 6.4 to 11.8)'. Only D_BUF and D_ABS sit in a sentence that names the contraction, in all three variants, so only they are printed that way. D_PRE has its own sentence, 'The 2022-to-2024 pre-trend is <<D_PRE>> square inches per year', which does not name the contraction, so it is printed signed.
_ledger_slot: ledger_slot names the ledger entry a slot prints when the two names differ. N_CALLED and N_GAMES print P0, the Chapter 1 primary sample (D-R0-02, D-P4-05, DEV-47), which export_numbers.R carries from W3.5's T1_sample.csv as N_CALLED_P0 and N_GAMES_P0. The ledger's own N_CALLED and N_GAMES are W6.4's ABS-measured-cohort counts; W6.4's --check owns them, and the abstract does not print them.
_digits: digits sets decimals by units; a slot's own digits overrides it. A_PUB is printed whole, as Clemens published it (8 to 22), signed like A_CORR beside it.
_owner_review: Orientation, digits and suffixes are presentation choices fixed before any real number exists. Review R1 may change them here, never in the abstract text.
_owner_variant: The owner-voice variant (abstract/variants/ssac2027_abstract.owner.md, the owner's instruction recorded in DECISIONS.md D-P6-02) adds the slots below D_TOTAL. Three of them read an existing entry through ledger_slot in the contraction orientation (A_CORR_LOSS, A_PUB_LOSS, HW_BUF_LOSS), so export_numbers.R writes print_contraction on A_CORR, A_PUB and T1_BUF_HW beside their signed print; the older variants still print those entries signed. AREA_2022 to AREA_2026 print the point alone (kind value), in a sentence whose bound is D_TOTAL's interval. SHARE_ABS is a percentage (100 times T4's share_abs ratio, digits 0) printed as a point, and SHARE_ABS_CI prints its interval as a range so the sentence can read 'N percent ... (95% CI L to H)'. N_CHAL_AGREE is T2's n_agree beside N_CHAL.
_ch1_a5: A5_BUF, A5_ABS and A5_TOL carry CH1-A5's miss on the area into the descriptive variant's Conclusion, where the frozen rule reports it as a limitation. W6.7 writes them from T4_decomposition.csv: binned_minus_bam for delta_buffer and delta_abs, and ch1_a5_tolerance. A5_BUF and A5_ABS are printed in the contraction orientation, so a binned loss larger than the smooth fit's reads as a positive number in a sentence that calls the binned losses larger. A5_TOL is printed whole, as the tolerance is written.
_descriptive: P1_AREA, P1_SHADOW, P2_AREA_MAX and the four T1_ edge slots are read only by the descriptive variant (DECISIONS.md D-P6-01), written because placebo P1 failed and the frozen consequence of CH1-A3 applies. The two top-edge slots are printed as drops (orient contraction), so a top edge that moved down reads as a positive number in a sentence that says it came down. The two bottom-edge slots are printed signed, and a positive bottom edge moved up. Both orientations are fixed here, not in the text.
